log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed only national (no info leak). Quick entries must be in morning/afternoon (night worker). Watch press conf after day 3 to gauge which leaks L has; pool<=300k means caught. Source-only kills leak source if L traces it; timing leaks routine if deaths in busy blocks (timed entries max 2/day).

Day1 and Day2: killed only national (quick, morning). No info leak so far. Quick entries only in morning/afternoon (night worker). Press conf after day 3 shows pool; pool<=300k means caught. Source-only kills leak the source if L traces it; deaths in busy blocks (evening/night) leak routine, timed entries max 2/day. Consider adding source kills gradually to gauge L from pool announcements.

Day3: killed national + 2 regional + 2 web (quick, morning/afternoon). Never use evening/night blocks. Watch the day-3 press conf (comes after day 3) for pool size: if it drops to about 2-4M, L traces regional/web. Pool must stay >300k; the real pool never grows. Announcements may be off by 3x, so compare across several. Add sources cautiously only if the pool stays high.

Day4: killed national only (quick, morning). Press conf after day3 said 1M (maybe off by 3x: true 333k-3M). Pool near the 300k limit is dangerous. Days 1-2 national only; day 3 added regional+web kills and pool dropped from 10M to 1M, so L likely traces regional and/or web (and maybe timing, since I used morning and afternoon blocks). Stay with national-only kills, quick, morning. Do not kill regional or web sources again. Next press conf is after day 6; if pool is still about 1M or more, continue cautiously; avoid new sources.

Next press conf is after day 6; if the pool is still about 1M or more, continue cautiously and avoid new sources.
